answer.text: Lower than comparable plain vanilla (bondholder option has value)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Putable bond = bondholder has option to sell back → they pay for that flexibility (lower yield). **The Trap:** Callable is opposite (bondholder gives option, gets higher yield). **Cross-Exam Context:** IV. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Indian market: putable bonds rare; callable PSU bonds more common.
